title: Le Creuset stoneware
text: Le Creuset stoneware. This is the Le Creuset ceramic line... NOT cast iron... The colors are about the same in all of their lines.  Mydaughter likes the red color in their lines.  This was a little disappointing as it was a Christmas gift for my daughter... she picked it out (safer that way!).  The bad news is the first one arrived in pieces. She reports you could actually hear it shattered in the box before opening it. Sigh.  NOT such a great gift.  I had to then have my daughter hassle through the return process in order to get a replacement.  NOT cool.  Eventually the replacement arrived, and good news, it was whole.  So much for the gifting process on this particular gift.
